metadata.title: Email Bulk Messaging Gateway

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for sending high-volume institutional email with explicit authorization, consent awareness, abuse prevention, and reputational protection.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Bulk email platforms, list management systems, rate-limiting services, and outbound reputation controls.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Pattern for governing high-volume outbound email while preventing spam, abuse, and unauthorized mass communication.

props.name: depends-on
props.remarks: Bulk messaging assumes baseline email delivery, identity binding, and accountability are established.

metadata.remarks: Email Bulk Messaging Gateway defines trust properties required to safely execute high-volume outbound email campaigns. This pattern addresses authorization, consent alignment, abuse prevention, and reputational risk, and is distinct from threat protection or system notification messaging.

components.title: Bulk Send Authorization
components.description: Ensures only explicitly authorized identities and systems may initiate bulk email campaigns.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Abuse of valid accounts to send unauthorized bulk email.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Privileged access control over bulk messaging capabilities.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Bulk email send privileges are limited to authorized roles following least privilege.
Bulk email initiation is attributable to authenticated identities.

components.title: Rate Limiting and Abuse Prevention
components.description: Prevents misuse of bulk messaging systems through throttling and anomaly detection.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Use of email at scale for phishing or deceptive campaigns.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Monitoring and alerting to detect abnormal bulk email behavior.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Bulk email activity is monitored to detect anomalous or abusive patterns.
Abusive or unauthorized bulk messaging triggers incident response actions.

components.title: Recipient Consent and Scope Alignment
components.description: Aligns bulk email distribution with recipient expectations, consent, and institutional policy.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Manipulation of mailing lists or recipient scope to overreach intended audiences.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Policy enforcement to constrain inappropriate data and message distribution.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Policies define allowable use of bulk email and appropriate recipient scope.
Controls reduce the risk of inappropriate dissemination of sensitive information via bulk email.

components.title: Bulk Email Auditability
components.description: Provides traceability and accountability for bulk messaging activity.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Deletion or suppression of evidence related to bulk messaging misuse.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Audit logging to support accountability and investigation.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Bulk email send events are captured as auditable records.
Audit review supports oversight of bulk email campaigns.
